sources.title: Anthropic, Prompt caching (Claude API documentation)

quotes.text: Place static content (tool definitions, system instructions, context, examples) at the beginning of your prompt.
Changes at each level invalidate that level and all subsequent levels.
Regularly analyze cache hit rates and adjust your strategy as needed.
Cache hits and refreshes on Claude Fable 5.2, Claude Mythos 5.2, Claude Fable 5.1, and Claude Mythos 5.1 are priced at 0.025x the base input price.
All other models use the standard 0.1x multiplier.
